l4_icans_grade_steroids.quote: Treat the likely ICANS: after CT head excludes haemorrhage, start dexamethasone 10 mg IV every 6 hours. Do not wait for MRI or LP to start it.

l4_crs_management.quote: Give a 500 mL crystalloid bolus and reassess, avoiding overload given that capillary leak can accompany CRS.

l4_neutropenic_sepsis.quote: Take two blood cultures (one peripheral, one from the central line) without delaying antibiotics, then start empirical meropenem within the hour; add vancomycin

l4_airway_icu_seizure.quote: Neuro checks with ICE and GCS every hour, strict NPO while vomiting, head of bed 30 degrees, seizure precautions, and a low threshold for airway protection

l4_ddx_cns_relapse.quote: CNS lymphoma relapse: his CNS-IPI was high and he has progressive systemic disease, but the 2026 MRI and CSF were negative and acute onset of this kind is uncommon.

l4_ddx_infection_bleed.quote: Infection with CNS involvement, which can coexist with ICANS. Neutropenic bacteraemia or meningitis (febrile, ANC 0.2, central line, CRP 214); HSV or VZV encephalitis despite prophylactic acyclovir;

l4_ddx_metabolic_seizure.quote: Non-convulsive status epilepticus or subclinical seizures: aphasia and confusion can be the only signs

l4_ct_then_mri.quote: STAT non-contrast CT head to exclude haemorrhage, mass effect and oedema

l4_eeg_lp_safe.quote: Lumbar puncture once platelets are at least 50 and imaging excludes mass effect: opening pressure, cell count, protein, glucose, Gram stain and culture, fungal culture, cryptococcal antigen, HSV 1 and 2, VZV, HHV-6

l4_glucose_steroids_diabetes.quote: switch the insulin correction scale to basal plus correction insulin for glucose 242 on dexamethasone

l4_mn_lp_unsafe.quote: Transfuse platelets to at least 50 before any lumbar puncture.

l4_mn_withhold_steroids_for_tcell.quote: start dexamethasone 10 mg IV every 6 hours. Do not wait for MRI or LP to start it.
